plain.tool: animate_object v3 on the object, one direction, frame_count 6, keep_first_frame false (6 stored frames, frame_000 the first generated); the blow lands on frame 3

rat attack S.action: lunges toward the viewer, the head and front legs reach down and forward 2-3 px, then back to its stance, feet planted, nothing else appears in the frame

rat attack N.action: lunges away from the viewer, the head and front legs reach up and forward 2-3 px, then back to its stance, feet planted, nothing else appears in the frame

slime attack S.action: no legs, no feet, a blob the whole time: it squashes down flat, then surges forward and up, then settles, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

cistern_spider attack E.action: rears its front legs and strikes down with its fangs, then returns to its stance, feet planted, nothing else appears in the frame

kobold_tosher attack E.action: thrusts its spear forward with both hands, then returns to its stance, feet planted, nothing else appears in the frame

hive_wasp attack E.action: darts forward and jabs with its stinger, wings beating, then returns to its stance, nothing else appears in the frame

culvert_bat death S.action: stops flapping, falls to the floor on its back, wings spread, and lies still, eyes closed, nothing else appears in the frame

slime death S.action: melts flat into a puddle and lies still, no legs, no feet, the same colours throughout, nothing else appears in the frame

rat_king death S.action: collapses and falls face down, his cape spread, the bone sceptre beside him, and lies still, eyes closed, nothing else appears in the frame

kobold_tosher death S.action: falls flat on its back, the spear beside it, and lies still, eyes closed, nothing else appears in the frame
